subject: Stellarus onsite workshop — travel & hotel exception request
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 08:12 -0800
Subject: Stellarus onsite workshop — travel & hotel exception request

Hannah / Laura / Monica —

Stellarus (Tom Evans) confirmed the onsite workshop for Dec 8–10 at their Milwaukee HQ. We need to finalize travel for their three executives and our two leads (Jonas + Monica). A couple of details that fall outside standard policy and need signoff: 

- Executive arrival: Stellarus requested an early-morning arrival on Dec 8 for a 8:30am briefing. That forces outbound flights on Dec 7 late evening with a same-day red-eye, or an overnight the night of Dec 6. The execs prefer an overnight stay on Dec 6 (additional night) due to tight schedule.
- Hotel class: Stellarus is covering the conference room but recommended downtown Hyatt Grand. The quoted corporate rate would exceed our standard per-night cap by ~$180 per room for two nights.
- Ground transfer: They are asking for an executive sedan pickup from airport; policy ordinarily uses ride-share.

Attached: itinerary_proposal.pdf (draft with times & nominal costs).

Can Laura estimate incremental cost for the hotel + extra night and alternatives? Marissa — is there room to approve a partial exception for client-facing executive travel on this account? If we need leadership signoff I can route it. Stellaurs is a high priority expansion opportunity (named account) and would be onsite-hosted by them; they asked us to cover the additional night and sedan for the execs. 

Next steps I propose: Laura to provide cost breakdown, Marissa to confirm max exception threshold, then Hannah to approve final spend and instruct travel vendor to book.

Thanks —
Jonas
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 11:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Stellarus onsite workshop — travel & hotel exception request

Thanks Jonas —

I pulled preliminary quotes from our vendor for the suggested dates and the Hyatt Grand downtown:

- Room: $420/night (standard king) — our internal cap: $240/night. Incremental = $180/night x 2 rooms x 2 nights = $720.
- Extra night (Dec 6): 2 rooms x $420 = $840 incremental (vs. if they arrived Dec 7).
- Exec sedan transfers: $85 one-way x 2 execs x 2 trips = $340.

Total incremental cost (hotel uplift + extra night + sedan): $1,900.

Alternative lower-cost plan:
- Book at Riverwalk Hotel (corporate rate $265/night) — saves about $310 total vs Hyatt; still closer to cap but less lift.
- Keep standard ground rides (ride-share) and provide a curated Lyft profile for execs.

Attached: cost_matrix.xlsx with line items and vendor contact (Emily Lang, Bluebird Travel). If leadership approves a partial exception, I can ask Bluebird to hold inventory for 48 hours.

Laura
Senior Travel Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the breakdown, Laura. I reviewed the numbers and the Stellarus opportunity details in SFDC (deal: STEL-3302). Given this is a strategic expansion account and the customer asked us to cover the incremental night and transfers, finance can approve up to $1,200 in exception spend from the events budget. That's roughly covering either the Hyatt uplift OR the extra night, but not both.

Two asks before I can finalize the approval:
1) Please complete the travel exception form and attach exec names (policy link: https://app.redwood.com/travel-exceptions/form/REX-7821).
2) Confirm that the invoice will route to billing@redwood.com and that we have an itemized vendor invoice for reconciliation.

If you want full coverage, we'd need a one-off credit approval from the CFO (I can escalate with a short rationale doc).

Marissa Cole
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Team / Emily / Tom —

Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Finance will approve up to $1,200 from our events budget. After discussing options, we've decided to:

- Book Riverwalk Hotel at the corporate rate ($265/night) for our two Redwood leads (Jonas & Monica) — this keeps the hotel uplift modest.
- Approve the extra night (Dec 6) for our execs only if we can shift one of the Hyatt nights to a lower-rate property should hotel inventory change; otherwise finance covers the extra night up to the $1,200 cap.
- Approve sedan pickups for executive arrivals on Dec 8 (one-way per exec) — please provide vendor invoice to billing@redwood.com.

Emily — please hold the Riverwalk rooms and propose two itineraries (A: Hyatt for execs + Riverwalk for Redwood leads; B: Riverwalk for all) with exact flight options and final cost. Bluebird should send an itemized invoice and a booking link; route all invoices to billing@redwood.com.

Jonas / Monica — please confirm final attendee names and whether any of the guests have dietary or accessibility needs we should pass to the venue.

I've attached the completed travel_exception_form_filled.pdf (signed) for records. Once Emily sends the final quote, Laura please confirm and instruct booking.

Hannah Schmitt
